reason: My customers already read my WhatsApp messages and that costs me nothing, and I've already put money into Facebook boosts this month. I don't see why I'd pay per message on top of that for an 11.11 sale.
objection: I have to sign up and top up before I can even see one message land on my own phone with my shop's name on it, and the name only comes after approval. If Sinhala messages eat two credits, I don't really know what a blast will cost me.
would_change_my_mind: A few free test SMS on signup so I can send one to my own phone under my shop name and see it arrive before I put any money in.
